courts.intro: Set the venue's court rules before play and every draw follows them. Rounds already drawn keep their courts; elimination rounds that have not started are re-drawn when you save. Courts can still be changed by hand on any game.
courts.auxiliaryDescription: Optional: Identify any courts that have a less than optimal playing surface. These can fall out of use as teams are eliminated.
courts.noMainCourts: At least one court has to be a main court
courts.spreadAuxiliary: Keep any team from playing more than one game on them
courts.spreadAuxiliaryPlayers: Keep any player from playing more than one game on them
courts.byRoundDescription: Optional: Specify which courts are available for draw at each round of the tournament. Assignments are drawn at random from the available set of courts but may be overridden by setting 'Featured Courts' below. Enter any combination of court numbers or ranges separated by a comma; for example: 1,3,5,7-12. Leave a row blank to keep the courts of the round before - once a string line comes out for the semifinals it stays out for the final.
courts.tooFewCourts: {{games}} games need a court; only {{count}} offered
courts.featuredDescription: Optional: Pre-assign particular matches to particular courts. For example, set the championship final where spectators can watch. Assign one court for each match in that round: one for a final, two for a semifinal, etc.
